plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Software-craft build-and-review from corpora of sourced rule cards — universal, Python and Java — a deterministic pre-pass, a finder per triggered card, a skeptic per finding, a developer agent that designs and builds by the cards

plugins.name: evidence-based-authoring
plugins.description: Evidence-based authoring: web research with source verification, AI context files whose rules name what they rest on, rules admitted by the scientific method with a record of the test each rests on, and reports and explanations told as a story with pictures and a checkable list, sent as text or as a page with voice, with questions as decision cards
